title: C Quick Reference
description: Find a word or command you have seen in a lesson. Each short note tells you what it does. Open the linked lesson for the full example.

entries.name: main
entries.summary: The starting function of this C program.

entries.name: printf
entries.summary: Print text and values to the terminal.

entries.name: gcc
entries.summary: Compile a C file into a program.

entries.name: int
entries.summary: Store a whole number such as a pencil count.

entries.name: double
entries.summary: Store a decimal number such as 2.5.

entries.name: if
entries.summary: Run a step only when a condition is true.

entries.name: for
entries.summary: Repeat steps while a loop condition is true.

entries.name: while
entries.summary: Repeat steps while a rule stays true.
Find the remainder after integer division.

entries.name: return
entries.summary: Send a result back from a function.

entries.name: Array
entries.summary: Keep several values of the same type in order.

entries.name: String ending
entries.summary: A C string ends with a zero character.

entries.name: strlen
entries.summary: Count characters before the string ending.

entries.name: sizeof
entries.summary: Find the size of a type or value in bytes.

entries.name: struct
entries.summary: Keep related fields in one value.
Get the address of a variable.
Read or change a value through a pointer.
Reach a struct field through a pointer.

entries.name: malloc
entries.summary: Ask for a block of memory; check for NULL.

entries.name: free
entries.summary: Give back a memory block from malloc.

entries.name: fopen
entries.summary: Open a file; NULL means opening failed.

entries.name: fclose
entries.summary: Close a file you finished using.

entries.name: fgetc
entries.summary: Read one character, or EOF at the end.

entries.name: #include
entries.summary: Read declarations from a header file.

entries.name: Include guard
entries.summary: Stop a header body from being included twice.
